hypothesis: Unrestricted residual correction can overwrite high-confidence correct baseline decisions or choose a class supported by neither branch. A bounded binary selector addresses both failure modes.
design_motivation: Available-corrector failure inspection on held data; explicitly exploratory, not a fresh confirmatory validation. Threshold .8 is reused from original corrector confidence protection, never scanned.
training: Only both-primary-valid disagreements where label is one of the two branch choices; labels outside choices cannot distinguish the branches and are excluded from selector training. All such confidence levels used for training. AdamW lr.01 weight_decay.01, CE,100epochs,batch64,finalFP32 stored state, no early stopping.
routing: Only both-primary-valid, branches disagree, baseline softmax max<.8. Select temporal or visual top1; no new class. Everything else retains exact baseline logits.
known_limitation: Meta-OOF engineering screen using target-pretrained upstream; not clean unseen-user CV. No test data/labels or leaderboard feedback in design.
stopping_rule: One fixed recipe; no threshold/feature/epoch/seed selection on these outcomes; no full-fit or test inference unless every gate passes.
